source_claim: AlphaEvolve-scale provider-call evidence should identify model calls that produced proposals, LLM feedback, and meta-prompt evolution without confusing retained diagnostics with replayable raw provider outputs; local critique-role diagnostics are extra runtime telemetry rather than a detailed paper-method surface
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has provider usage metadata, request/response ids, finish reasons, adapter retry metadata, provider failure categories, provider status codes, bounded provider diagnostics, backend defaults metadata, retained call-history windows, provider-diagnostics summary schema, records hashes, raw-payload replay overclaim checks, remote provider-default overclaim checks, and backend-default count checks. It does not claim raw provider-payload sidecars, provider output replay, complete provider-call replay, or account/model default capture.
